user.title: Connect to HiveMind
user.description: The address of your HiveMind (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:4820) and an API token from HiveMind → Settings → API tokens.

reauth_confirm.title: New HiveMind API token
reauth_confirm.description: HiveMind refused the token. Make a new one in HiveMind → Settings → API tokens.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach HiveMind at this address. Check the address and port (default 4820) and that Home Assistant can reach that machine.

abort.already_configured: This HiveMind is already added (a new working token was saved).

init.title: HiveMind options
init.description: Pick the canvases that become Assist agents and buttons (none picked = all). New canvases made in HiveMind show up after reloading the integration.

data.button_text: Text a button press sends to its canvas

abort.not_loaded: HiveMind is not loaded right now (server offline or token refused). Fix that first, then open the options again.

run_canvas.name: Run canvas
run_canvas.description: Runs a HiveMind canvas with a question and returns its final answer.

canvas.name: Canvas
canvas.description: The canvas id or name (see HiveMind → Settings → OpenAI API).

text.name: Text
text.description: The question or instruction for the canvas.

config_entry_id.name: HiveMind server
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when you added more than one HiveMind.
